probes.pass_criteria: A hardware-backed or hypervisor-signed attestation, verified by the host controller against a separately pinned platform trust root, binds the guest instance and measured isolation boundary; provider API claims alone are insufficient.
probes.fail_closed: Attestation is absent, unverifiable, stale, not bound to this instance, or supplied only as an unverified provider claim.

probes.pass_criteria: The attested guest boot measurement and host-observed kernel identity prove a dedicated guest kernel distinct from the host; guest uname output or provider metadata alone is insufficient.
probes.fail_closed: Guest kernel identity is shared, unmeasured, stale, ambiguous, or supported only by guest/provider self-report.

probes.pass_criteria: Guest process is non-root and has no effective, permitted, inheritable, ambient, or bounding capabilities.
probes.fail_closed: UID is privileged or any disallowed capability remains.

probes.pass_criteria: Seccomp filter is active and a harmless explicitly selected denied syscall returns the expected policy denial.
probes.fail_closed: Filter is absent, permissive, or denial is not attributable to policy.

probes.pass_criteria: Host independently reads finite CPU, memory, and PID limits and observes bounded harmless workload behavior.
probes.fail_closed: Any limit is unlimited, writable by guest, unenforced, or not host-observable.

probes.pass_criteria: Host observes a finite enforced writable-layer quota and bounded test writes stop at policy boundary.
probes.fail_closed: Quota is absent, unlimited, bypassable, or evidence is guest-only.

probes.pass_criteria: Source mount rejects writes while designated scratch mount accepts bounded writes.
probes.fail_closed: Source is writable or scratch is unavailable/unbounded.

probes.pass_criteria: Host verifies host home directories and secret mounts are not exposed; guest inventory contains no injected host credentials.
probes.fail_closed: Any host home, credential file, token, or secret mount is reachable.

probes.pass_criteria: Host verifies Docker/container-runtime sockets, host control sockets, and unapproved devices are not passed through.
probes.fail_closed: Any host control socket or unapproved device is exposed.

probes.pass_criteria: A harmless request to the provider metadata test endpoint is blocked and independently observed by host/canary.
probes.fail_closed: Metadata endpoint returns data or request path cannot be independently observed.

probes.pass_criteria: Controlled IPv4 canary receives no guest-originated connection during the bounded probe window.
probes.fail_closed: Canary observes a guest-originated connection.

probes.pass_criteria: Controlled IPv6 canary receives no guest-originated connection during the bounded probe window.
probes.fail_closed: Canary observes a guest-originated connection or IPv6 is untested.

probes.pass_criteria: Controlled UDP and TCP DNS queries cannot reach the external authoritative canary.
probes.fail_closed: Either transport reaches the canary or DNS is not independently measured.

probes.pass_criteria: A harmless UDP/443 canary packet flow is blocked and no external canary sees it.
probes.fail_closed: External UDP/443 traffic is observed or not independently measured.

probes.pass_criteria: A fresh per-attempt nonce is never observed by the canary across supported egress paths.
probes.fail_closed: Nonce is observed, canary identity is not independent, or logs are incomplete.

probes.pass_criteria: Host monotonic deadline terminates the entire runtime within the configured bounded grace period.
probes.fail_closed: Guest controls deadline, execution outlives host deadline, or only guest timestamp is used.

probes.pass_criteria: Host confirms all guest descendants are terminated after cancellation/timeout.
probes.fail_closed: Any descendant survives or host cannot independently enumerate descendants.

probes.pass_criteria: Host validates allowlisted artifact path, size ceiling, regular-file type, and recomputed SHA-256.
probes.fail_closed: Path traversal, symlink/device, size overrun, digest mismatch, or guest-only digest.

probes.pass_criteria: Host confirms runtime, mounts, network handles, temporary storage, and credentials are removed after success, failure, and timeout.
probes.fail_closed: Any resource or credential remains or one outcome path is untested.

probes.pass_criteria: Each attempt receives a fresh instance identity and cannot read a unique harmless marker from the prior attempt.
probes.fail_closed: Instance is reused without proven reset or prior marker is observable.
